Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant 
would submit that the petitioner/appellant filed 
the civil appeal along with an application u/s 5 of 
the Limitation Act; that, III Additional District 
Judge, Haridwar, vide order dated 18.01.2020, 
was pleased to condone the delay in filing the 
appeal and directed to place the appeal before 
learned District Judge for admission. 
3. He would further submit respondent 
no.1/plaintiff filed an application u/s 151 of 
C.P.C. to set aside the order dated 18.01.2020; 
that, I Additional District Judge, Roorkee, vide 
impugned order dated 03.08.2023, set aside the 
order dated 18.01.2020 and fixed the case for 
hearing on the delay condonation application. 
4. Issue notice to the respondents through 
ordinary and registered post acknowledgment 
due as well as by Email and Whatsapp, if 
available.
5. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
6. List on 13.09.2024.
7. Till the next date of listing, the effect and 
operation of impugned order dated 03.08.2023 
shall remain stayed.
8. Stay Application IA No.1/2024 is disposed 
of.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 29.04.2024
Rajni
